editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood diner where comfort food classics like biscuits and gravy and fried chicken and waffles have been drawing loyal regulars back for decades.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the fried chicken and waffles—reviewers rave about how juicy and fresh the chicken is, with meat that falls right off the bone.
